articles.title: Finding and Registering for Courses
articles.distinction: Find and enroll oneself in non-PME self-paced MCeLE courses; distinguish this from PME eligibility/seminar enrollment, staff request review, and an already-enrolled course launch failure.

source_review.scope: Finding and enrolling oneself in non-PME self-paced MCeLE courses and curricula.
source_review.navigation: Course Catalog or Catalog Search, then View and Course Details.
source_review.eligibility: Use the green/red Eligibility text and displayed Enroll Now or Re-Enroll Now availability; do not infer that every role can enroll in every course.
source_review.enrollment_result: After enrollment, the course appears in My Courses (user correction on 2026-10-02).
source_review.source_gap: The source mentions Submit Course Request(s) and points to step 4, but step 4 describes launching already-enrolled courseware; it does not provide the request-submission procedure.
excluded_workflows: PME-specific eligibility or seminar enrollment requirements
Training Manager review of another user enrollment request
Troubleshooting launch of an already-enrolled course
source_review.source_gap_status: Request-form opening steps supplied by the user and included in the local draft. Form-specific completion/submission instructions remain outside the supplied guidance.

reviewed_guidance.scope: Own enrollment in non-PME self-paced MCeLE courses; PME enrollment follows separate rules.
course_request_steps: Go to My Courses and find the course.
Look in Overview for any available request forms.
Select Request to open the form.
reviewed_guidance.decision_source: User corrected the course location, agreed with the non-PME distinction and supplied the request-form path on 2026-10-02.

reviewed_access.scope: Own enrollment in non-PME self-paced MCeLE courses and curricula. Course eligibility still determines actual enrollment. PME enrollment and staff review of other users requests remain separate.
reviewed_access.decision_source: User answered YES on 2026-10-02 to the pending all-five-role audience question while VM reconnection proceeded in parallel.

articles.title: View Enrolled Courses
articles.distinction: Distinguish locating a course and checking its status from a failed Launch action or navigating within Moodle.

source_review.scope: Locate the user own MCeLE courses across enrollment statuses and explain common self-paced course actions. This does not supply enrollment eligibility or staff management procedures.
source_review.primary_navigation: Select Student Dashboard in the left navigation, then My Courses.
source_review.alternate_source_entry: MCeLE Portal Home > My In-Progress Courses; current widget label and intended status coverage remain to be confirmed.
listing_tools: Filter by course type, status, or category

source_actions.Launch: Open the course enrollment page, where associated course material, tests or surveys can be launched.
source_actions.View: Review completed-course content without enrolling again.
source_actions.Download Certificate: View, download or print a course certificate or diploma.
source_actions.Disenroll: Disenroll from the course; the source does not give a detailed procedure.
source_actions.Details: Open the Details dropdown under the title for the description and ACE, CEU and RRC credit amounts.
source_actions.Sub-Courses: Open the Sub-Courses dropdown under a curriculum title.
source_actions.Transcript: Request Official Transcript for colleges or employers, or Print Transcript for an unofficial transcript.

routing_distinctions: Locating a course or checking status versus enrollment or re-enrollment
Available Launch action versus troubleshooting a failed launch
MCeLE listing versus navigation and course materials inside Moodle
source_limits: Several action-table How to Access cells contain no step-by-step procedure; do not invent missing actions or guarantee every button appears for every course/status.
source_review.label_consistency_note: The existing curated Launch Course article still quotes My Active Courses. Resolve that label separately from the Portal Home widgets; do not assume all locations have the same label.
source_review.alternate_entry_status: Omitted from the reviewed draft; future optional entry needs separate label confirmation.

reviewed_access.scope: Own MCeLE course listings, statuses, common self-paced actions and records. No staff management of another user records or course eligibility rules.
reviewed_access.decision_source: User explicitly confirmed all five roles on 2026-10-02.

reviewed_guidance.primary_navigation: Student Dashboard in the left navigation > My Courses, including staff accessing their own courses.
reviewed_guidance.completed_course_distinction: View reviews completed-course content without enrolling again; retaking the course follows re-enrollment guidance.
reviewed_guidance.decision_source: User confirmed navigation and approved adding the View/re-enrollment distinction on 2026-10-02.
